summary: Dirt apron at the mouth of a powerline easement track off a rural road.
reasons: Pin sits on powerline easement track mouth
Track runs between pylons into bush

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind and farmland across the road; nearest house about 50 m away, so seclusion itself is good.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt apron meets the road, but it is the entry to a pylon access track, normally gated.
drivers.traffic: Rural main road, fast traffic, apron is clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: No vehicles, tents or tyre marks beyond the track itself.

flags: Steep: mean 10%, up to 40% on the DEM
Powerline easement track, access likely restricted
Nerang River about 83 m away, 43 to 47 m elevation so not low-lying
sun_shade: Open to sky; bush shade from the south-west.
cannot_judge: Whether a gate is placed at the track mouth
